text:
emma (finance): quick check-in on the billing postmortem actions. goal: confirm owners, narrow ETAs, and capture any blockers. root symptom: late ingestion + duplicate token writes led to wrong invoice amounts for a subset of customers.

emma (finance): proposed tasks: (feel free to edit)
```
A) sweep + reconcile token discrepancies (generate per-customer delta file) - owner: darren - ETA: 2026-03-12
B) idempotent backfill job to apply delayed usage - owner: li - ETA: 2026-03-13
C) generate corrective credit memos + ledger patch runbook - owner: marcus/brianna - ETA: 2026-03-15
D) add automated alert for consumer backlog + retry surge - owner: sofia - ETA: 2026-03-10
E) unit/integration test for dedupe + ordering edge-case - owner: darren/li - ETA: 2026-03-18
```

emma (finance): spreadsheet with affected accounts + rough credit estimate: https://redwood.internal/sheets/billing-remedials-2416 (please add GH issue links).

ops-bot: Incident ID: PG-2026-03-10-delayed-ingest logged. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PG-2026-03-10

darren (eng-infra): taking A and E. quick find: consumer requeue path doesn't set the dedupe token consistently, so retries can reapply counts. I'll instrument a counter and export a per-run CSV for validation. ETA for initial delta: 3/11 (will try earlier). GH #4301 created.

li (eng-ml): taking B. can we get the delta CSV format? prefer columns: customer_id, timestamp_window, delta_tokens, source_checksum. I can run parallel workers if finance allows a maintenance window. ETA 3/13 if window approved. GH #4305.

sofia (eng-sre): taking D. I'll add a new Prometheus rule: billing_ingest_backlog > 500 && avg_retry_rate > 3 for 5m, route to #eng-oncall and page SRE. also adding an ops playbook entry for switching to the warmed fallback consumer. ETA 3/10. GH #4302.

brianna (product): marcus and I will own C. priority: create list of impacted customers by ARR and mark manual review for top-30. we should send a preliminary customer note within 48h. drafting now. GH #4306.

marcus (finance-lead): added top-30 list to the sheet and a preliminary credit calc. I want an eng dry-run CSV and a checksum to validate before we issue credits. I'll coordinate approval workflow for credit memos. ETA 3/15 for full approvals. GH #4307.

darren (eng-infra): note: I'll include a checksum column (sha256 of original event ids) in the dry-run to help reconcile. will attach CSV in the sheet when ready.

li (eng-ml): please confirm retention policy for archived events. backfill logic will skip events older than 90 days unless finance approves.

emma (finance): good point. for customers >90d we'll handle case-by-case; mark those rows with "aged" and we'll route to Marcus for approval.

sofia (eng-sre): also adding a short-term monitoring dashboard: ingestion lag, retry_rate, dedupe_failures, and per-region backlog. will share link when done.

brianna (product): tentative customer comm: "We identified delayed usage processing that affected billing for a subset of customers. We're issuing credits for impacted usage and will share details in a follow-up." sharing draft soon.

marcus (finance-lead): question for eng: can the backfill job be dry-run against a sandbox ledger to produce an expected delta without mutating prod? need this for approvals.

darren (eng-infra): yes — will run dry-run into billing-sandbox and produce CSV + reconcile diff. same GH issue #4301.

li (eng-ml): will run idempotency checks on dry-run and compare checksums. if results match, sign-off for live backfill.

emma (finance): two operational asks: 1) add GH links to the sheet ACTION column; 2) set a Slack reminder 24h prior to each ETA and add a final remediation review meeting on 3/19.

darren (eng-infra): added GH #4301 to sheet. reminder set.

li (eng-ml): GH #4305 added. reminder set for 3/12 09:00.

sofia (eng-sre): GH #4302 added. weekly health-check scheduled for next 4 weeks to watch for regressions.

brianna (product): GH #4306 added. I'll post the customer note for review by EOD tomorrow.

marcus (finance-lead): GH #4307 added. I requested legal review for the credit memos flow.

emma (finance): great. I'll track progress in the postmortem tracker and run the 3/19 remediation review. If anyone's ETA slips, update the sheet and ping me. thanks all. :handshake:
